setting_choice: Use one common SGD configuration minimizing the average of tied and released mean calibration query over the already completed SGD calibration grids. No target outcomes enter selection.
reason: Declared after the main experiment: its calibration revealed similar plain-SGD performance despite a large advantage of tuned codebook Adam. Isolate retaining equality under exactly the same plain SGD and step size on another independent numerical cohort.
scope: One fixed source library, three frozen priors, fresh C and amplitude. New cohort; no additional calibration training. Same proposals, norms, minibatches and query in each pair; float32 initial-weight differences audited. This is a follow-up, not part of the original predeclared experiment.
